official_definition: The opponent chooses one among the following: Core Step/Draw Step/Main Step/Attack Step. On the next turn, the chosen step doesn't occur for the opponent. Each step of your Enchain can only be chosen once per game.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Enchain] or [Enchain: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Enchain]", "give [Enchain]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
